name: f7-trend-marking-v1
idea_origin: trace diagnosis of the 38 cloud Haiku digests (lab/reports/cloud-run-diagnostics/block3-generation.md, tables 2-4) and distilled Opus rule R3 'judge statistics by trend, not size' (lab/reports/teacher-digests/distilled-rules.md)
hypothesis: Reviews reward Output and Network being at their recent high when the review lands: across 127 reviews at Level 1-2, a B or a promotion followed 33 of 62 reviews with both at their high, 9 of 24 with Output only, 6 of 28 with Network only and 1 of 13 with neither; every one of the 14 first-review promotions had Output at its high (12 of 24 non-promoted games did not). The leader marks dimensions at risk by size and after any C or D, and every first review is a C, so the marks stop carrying information: in e373478a-04 Network was marked at risk in 62 of 88 story decisions below Level 3, 37 of them with Network at its high, and its two C reviews at Level 2 came with Network (review 2) and Output (review 3) below their high. Marking Skill, Network and Output at risk only when below their recent high makes the leader's own story rule 1 shield a stat that fell, its Energy rule restore it, and its main action default to a key project, so more reviews find Output and Network at their high.
change: risk-review step 2: Skill, Network and Output are marked at risk when below their recent high ('judge these three by trend, not by size or by a review grade'); the 'Output after a C or D review' clause is dropped; Health/Dignity, Network/Wealth near zero and warnings unchanged. story-decisions rule 2: 'help the weakest dimension' -> 'help a dimension at risk'. quarterly-planning: Prepare report materials added as the restore action for Output; main action 'cover the weakest dimension that Energy did not reach ... after a C or D review prefer Report results or Showcase results' -> 'cover a dimension still at risk after Energy, otherwise Apply for a key project'. Shared trims in all three block-3 children (no strategy change): shorter front-matter descriptions with the same 'Use ...' triggers; the redundant line 'Do this before every decision.' removed; the check_latest_logs line shortened to the context-reset case; quarterly step 4 ('Keep the same rules all run; near the end, avoid new risks.') removed because 'near the end' is a run-phase trigger the block-3 brief forbids. Manifest instruction kept identical to the parent's routing sentence (the generic template has an empty instruction; keeping it avoids a routing confound). 332 words by wc -w (parent 398).
predicted_behaviour: Notes mark Skill, Network or Output at risk after a fall and rarely at their high: under 0.1 marks of Network or Output at its high per story decision below Level 3 (parent digests: 68 marks in 156 decisions, 0.44). After a fall, the next Energy phase restores it (Prepare report materials or Network maintenance) in at least 3 of 4 cases; main action Apply for a key project whenever nothing is still at risk; Report results/Showcase only to cover a fallen stat. Output and Network both at their high at 2/3 or more of reviews below Level 3 (parent 3 of 6; population 62 of 127). First promotion at review 1 in at least 3 of 4 runs, no C at Level 2 or above in at least 3 of 4 runs, 4 of 4 completed, mean quantitative_score at or above the parent's raw mean (59.7).
refutation: On a 4-run Haiku screen against f7-three-skills-v1: refuted if the manipulation holds (under 0.1 marks at the high per story decision) but the share of reviews below Level 3 with Output and Network at their high is not above the parent's, or C grades at Level 2 or above occur in 2 or more runs, or mean quantitative_score falls below the parent's by more than the decision margin, or a dismissal or trust crisis occurs (parent 0 of 5). Uninformative, not refuted, if Haiku keeps marking by size (manipulation fails).
notes: Single mechanism: what counts as 'at risk' for the three growth statistics. Story rule 1 and the Energy order are the parent's; only their input changes. Nested contrast with f7-delivery-stories-v1 (active story preference, parent marking) and f7-promotion-drive-v1 (stall slot). The panel's growth statistics stop rising at each level (no number appears in the Skill; 'recent high' is read from the run's own observations). Risk: dropping 'Output after a C or D' could leave Output unprotected after a weak review if Output has not visibly fallen; the screen's review-time Output check covers this. Lint: see block3-generation.md.
